title: Interact with object
stage: six-pose interaction prototype generated and reviewed; continuity and in-engine review pending; not production approved

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Lanterns Underroot TAVI-019, a single individual full-body game sprite frame for a right-facing reach-and-press object interaction. Input reference: approved Tavi turnaround, identity/style reference only. Match exactly this original boy: short spiky cobalt blue hair, warm peach skin, cream rolled-sleeve tunic, red scarf clasped at shoulder and trailing behind left, brown leather harness, brown gloves with visible fingers, belt pouch, charcoal pants, tall brown buckled boots, short sword sheathed at belt. Clean illustrated 2D fantasy platformer style matching the turnaround. Calm focused expression and eyes open. Same right-facing side/three-quarter view, same scale and perspective for all poses, fixed feet planted on same baseline; both boots fully visible. Entire body including hair, scarf, fingertips, sheath fits with generous clear padding. Isolated opaque character cutout on genuinely transparent alpha. Neutral even lighting. No aura, glow, gradients, haze, particles, vignette, colored rimlight, cast shadows, panels, text, labels, other figures, floor, environment, object, switch or furniture. Prop is external to sprite. No sword attack, hurt or death pose. Single pose only. Portrait canvas 1024x1536; character occupies about 75% of canvas height. FRAME 05 — retract: right elbow draws back toward waist, hand moving inward after the press, torso returning upright; far hand relaxed.
sources.review: rejected for active sequence: opposite arm retracted

The OTHER arm visible along the LEFT side of the image must remain hanging straight down beside the pouch. Do not raise that left-side arm. Preserve the exact boy, blue hair, peach skin, cream tunic, red scarf, leather costume, face, head, sheathed sword, boots, stance, camera, body proportions, canvas and rendering. Feet stay pixel-aligned. Character only, transparent background, NO prop, no glow, no aura, no cast shadow, no text. One full-body pose.

review_notes: Identity colors match approved Tavi: blue hair, peach skin, cream tunic, red scarf.
Reusable reach-and-press motion; target object remains separate. Generated contact is closer to chest height than prompt waist-height target.
Review hand anatomy, fixed-foot alignment, consistent arm length and exact prop contact position before runtime use. Generated soft halos remain in the originals and preserved alpha.
Scale normalized by hair bounds; not tested in Godot. Runtime integration not requested.
